args.article: Today's AI agent landscape is maturing rapidly. Open-source frameworks are reaching production scale as adoption triples, while model-driven agents are replacing hand-coded orchestration in startups. Tool-calling reliability has become the key benchmark for frontier models, and multi-agent swarms are transitioning from demos to regulated enterprise workflows. Meanwhile, new observability standards are emerging to trace agent decisions end to end.
